terms.heading: Terms of use
terms.intro: Please read the following before using this app.
terms.unofficial: This is an unofficial app built on Irodori-TTS, the speech synthesis model published by Aratako under the MIT license.

ethics.impersonation: Do not clone or impersonate the voice of a real person without their explicit consent.
ethics.misinformation: Do not use it to spread misinformation or to create deceptive deepfakes.
ethics.resemblance: Voices created from a text description (caption) alone may coincidentally resemble real people.
ethics.liability: The developers accept no liability for the consequences of use. You are responsible for complying with the law.

terms.consent: Creating a voice from reference audio requires the consent of the person whose voice it is. The consent is recorded with the voice.
terms.watermark: Generated audio carries an inaudible SilentCipher watermark by default.
terms.privacy: This app sends no usage data (no telemetry). It connects to the internet only for the setup downloads, update checks, and the API server if you enable it.
terms.license: This app is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.
terms.agree: I have read and agree to the above

environment.heading: System check
environment.noGpu: No supported NVIDIA GPU was found

notices.cpu_mode_slow: The app will run in CPU mode. Generation takes far longer than on a GPU (minutes per sentence).
notices.no_nvidia_gpu: No supported NVIDIA GPU was found, so the app will use CPU mode.
notices.gpu_too_old: The GPU is too old (older than Volta), so the app will use CPU mode.
notices.vram_too_low: The GPU has less than 6 GB of memory, so the app will use CPU mode.
notices.low_vram_bf16: The GPU has less than 8 GB of memory, so the app will use bf16 precision to save memory.
notices.low_vram_fp32: The GPU has less than 8 GB of memory. Long texts may run out of memory.
notices.driver_update_recommended: The NVIDIA driver may be outdated. Updating to the latest version is recommended.
notices.m1_unsupported: M1 is not officially supported. The app may not work, or may be slow.
notices.low_memory: Less than 16 GB of memory. The app may be slow.

blockers.intel_mac: Macs with Intel processors are not supported. An Apple Silicon Mac is required.
blockers.unsupported_os: This operating system is not supported.

storage.heading: Storage folder
storage.description: The runtime (Python, PyTorch) and the model are stored here. About {{size}} of free space is needed. You can change this later.

install.heading: Setup
install.description: The required files are downloaded and installed. Several gigabytes are downloaded, so this can take a while.
install.keepOpen: Please keep the app open until setup finishes. If it is closed, setup continues where it stopped on the next launch.
